prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished grounded fantasy RPG inventory icon. Generate one isolated item on a genuinely transparent alpha background, square canvas. Physically convincing high quality 3D rendered appearance with natural detailed materials, matching realistic artisan copper ring inventory art. Three-quarter view, centered complete object, occupies about 75% canvas with generous transparent margin on every side. Soft upper-left key light, clear highlights and readable silhouette at 48 pixels. No frame, text, symbols, watermark, backdrop, floor, cast shadow, hands or extra objects. Subject: Starhide. Adult dragon hide steeped in deep magic. A folded dark indigo dragon hide with violet silver sheen across naturally pebbled leather and a few large overlapping scale ridges at one side. Restrained magical material, no stars floating outside.
sourceLookup: icon-audit/audit.json identifies procedural hide or cord geometry; icon_3d review confirms creature GLBs are whole beasts rather than hide/thread props. No suitable authored item model.
